ACT ONE

SCENE 1. A BARE STAGE

Two chairs face each other. ROSA sits in one. The other is empty.

ROSA

(to the empty chair)

You are late again. I counted the minutes, all forty of them.

TOMÁS enters, out of breath, holding a bunch of wilted flowers.

TOMÁS

The bus broke down. Then the florist was closed. Then it rained.

ROSA

And then?

TOMÁS

Then I ran.

BLACKOUT.
